name: Konkursy i loterie bez zakupu
description: Polish sweepstakes and prize competitions that require no purchase, or that offer a free method of entry, scraped daily from several sources and liveness-checked. Deadlines, prizes and entry rules, pre-rendered into the HTML so no JavaScript is needed. JSON at /data/lotteries.json. Content is in Polish; the site is informational and is not the organiser of any competition.
